title: The Forge Road
logline: A smith named Ayasa keeps a training yard on the forge road. {name} learns to roll, shove, climb, cut, block and draw a bow there, then walks the road and turns two raiders aside without hunting anyone.

objectives.text: Roll, shove and climb the marked ledge into Ayasa's forge yard.
Learn the sword and cross the forge yard.
Take up the bow and cross the archery range.
Turn the road-raiders aside and reach the gate.

dialogue.speaker: Ayasa
dialogue.text: {name}, this yard is for learning. Nothing here bites. Take what I leave on the ground, one lesson at a time.

dialogue.speaker: Ayasa
dialogue.text: A roll is not running away. Tap Dodge (X) to slip a blow, but it tires you. Roll twice.

dialogue.speaker: Ayasa
dialogue.text: Push (V) buys room, nothing more. Shove the straw post. A raider shoved off a ledge only has to climb back.

dialogue.speaker: Ayasa
dialogue.text: Marked ledges can be climbed. Face the stone and press Do (Space or F). No hurry.

dialogue.speaker: Ayasa
dialogue.text: Light cut J, heavy cut K. Hold Block (B) as my stick comes. Block just before it lands and you turn it aside.

dialogue.speaker: Ayasa
dialogue.text: Hold Draw (Z), let go to loose. Posts only. Pick your arrows up again; they are not endless.

dialogue.speaker: Ayasa
dialogue.text: Over the ledge. A wall climbed is a door most people never open. Now the blade.

dialogue.speaker: Ayasa
dialogue.text: You held your guard and nobody was hurt. Now the bow: breathe out, hold, then let go.

dialogue.speaker: Ayasa
dialogue.text: The road ahead has soldiers, and a captain. Block, roll, and wait for the opening. Turn them aside.

dialogue.speaker: Ayasa
dialogue.text: The gate stands open and the road is quiet. Keep it that way, {name}.

dialogue.speaker: Ayasa
dialogue.text: Turned aside, not hunted. Let them go home.

dialogue.speaker: Ayasa
dialogue.text: That was a parry. You used their strength and spent none of yours.

dialogue.speaker: {name}
dialogue.text: They have seen me. Roll if a blow comes, then shove or cut.

dialogue.speaker: Ayasa
dialogue.text: Breathe. Roll out of reach, then answer.

dialogue.speaker: Ayasa
dialogue.text: The yard waits. Come back, rest, and try the road again.

dialogue.speaker: Ayasa
dialogue.text: {name}, a sword sheathed has done its best work. You can roll, shove, climb, cut, block and shoot. Use them to shield someone.

dialogue.speaker: Ayasa
dialogue.text: Breathe. The next wave comes, and the same rule holds: wait for the opening.

dialogue.speaker: Ayasa
dialogue.text: The captain has changed his stance. Watch his wind-up and roll to the side.

dialogue.speaker: Ayasa
dialogue.text: The captain yields. Lower your hands, {name}. Let the road be quiet.

dialogue.speaker: Ayasa
dialogue.text: That is the opening. Take it once, cleanly, then step back.
